title: LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Limited LLM Benchmark
authors_zh: Colin White, Samuel Dooley, Manley Roberts, Arka Pal, Ben Feuer, Siddhartha Jain, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv, Neel Jain, Khalid Saifullah, Sreemanti Dey, Shubh-Agrawal, Sandeep Singh Sandha, Siddartha Naidu, Chinmay Hegde, Yann LeCun, Tom Goldstein, Willie Neiswanger, Micah Goldblum
paper_type_zh: 抗污染 benchmark 与评测协议
best_for_zh: 适合设计版本化客观评测，或审计 benchmark 泄漏风险的读者。
one_line: LiveBench combines dated task releases, periodic replacement, and objective scoring so model results can be audited against a specific contamination-limited benchmark version.
LiveBench 把带日期的任务版本、定期替换和客观评分组合起来，让模型结果能够对应一个明确的抗污染 benchmark 版本接受审计。
why: It makes the benchmark version and checker part of the evidence instead of treating a public test set as timeless.
inclusion_reason: LiveBench turns benchmark freshness, versioning, and objective scoring into an auditable contamination-limiting evaluation protocol.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Static LLM benchmarks lose diagnostic value after their public questions and answers enter training corpora, while open-ended LLM judges add another source of uncertainty. LiveBench asks how to compare models on hard tasks without treating a widely circulated test set as timeless evidence.

The paper builds a dated benchmark that combines recent or newly generated questions, objective task-specific scoring, and periodic replacement. Its direct output is a versioned evaluation record—prompt, response, checker, score, category, and release—not post-training supervision. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19314; venue: ICLR 2025 Spotlight.

公开题目与答案一旦进入训练语料，静态 LLM benchmark 就会逐渐失去诊断价值，而开放式 LLM judge 又引入另一层不确定性。LiveBench 想回答：如何在高难任务上比较模型，同时不把已经广泛流传的测试集当成永不过期的证据。

论文构建了一套带日期的 benchmark，把近期或新生成的问题、任务专用客观评分和定期替换组合起来。直接产物是一条版本化评测记录，包括 prompt、回答、checker、得分、类别和 release，而不是后训练监督数据。官方来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19314；会议：ICLR 2025 Spotlight。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LiveBench makes freshness and reproducibility part of the benchmark contract: every model score belongs to a dated task release and an explicit objective checker, while later releases replace stale material. Unlike a static leaderboard or an LLM-judged arena, the auditable object is the versioned prompt-response-score record; this places the work in foundations and evaluation auditing rather than training-data construction.

Google Scholar citations: 125（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LiveBench%3A+A+Challenging%2C+Contamination-Limited+LLM+Benchmark&author=Colin+White&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes.

  • Name and locations: LiveBench, https://huggingface.co/livebench and https://github.com/LiveBench/LiveBench.
  • Paper-release scale: 1,000 questions across 18 tasks and six categories; newer releases change over time.
  • Form: task prompts, answer data or task-specific scorers, release metadata, and evaluation harness files; category datasets are published separately on Hugging Face.
  • License: the paper states that the official repository is Apache-2.0; source-specific dataset terms still need checking.
  • Intended use: contamination-aware LLM evaluation, leaderboard reproduction, and release-to-release regression analysis.

LiveBench 把新鲜度和可复现性写进 benchmark 契约：每个模型分数都对应一个带日期的任务 release 和明确的客观 checker，后续版本再替换过时材料。与静态排行榜或由 LLM 评审的 arena 不同，需要审计的对象是版本化的 prompt—回答—得分记录；因此它属于基础与评测审计，而不是训练数据构造。

Google Scholar 引用数：125（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=LiveBench%3A+A+Challenging%2C+Contamination-Limited+LLM+Benchmark&author=Colin+White&hl=en）

开源数据：有。

  • 名称与地址：LiveBench，https://huggingface.co/livebench 和 https://github.com/LiveBench/LiveBench。
  • 论文版本规模：1,000 道题，覆盖 18 个任务和 6 个类别；更新版本会随时间变化。
  • 形式：任务 prompt、答案数据或任务专用 scorer、release 元数据和评测程序；各类别数据在 Hugging Face 分别发布。
  • 许可证：论文说明官方代码仓库使用 Apache-2.0；不同来源数据的条款仍需分别检查。
  • 预期用途：考虑污染风险的 LLM 评测、排行榜复现，以及跨 release 的回归分析。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define refreshable tasks. Input recent competitions, publications, news, code, and tabular sources plus task generators; construct difficult questions in mathematics, coding, reasoning, language, instruction following, and data analysis. Output task records with source dates.
  2. Attach objective checks. Give each task a ground-truth answer, executable test, or task-specific metric; reject tasks that require an unconstrained LLM judge for the core score. The checker determines when a response counts as correct.
  3. Freeze a release. Package 1,000 questions over 18 tasks and six categories in the paper version, with prompt and scorer versions. A model result must name this release rather than only saying “LiveBench.”
  4. Run and aggregate. Generate model responses under pinned endpoint and decoding settings, score each with its task checker, then aggregate task and category scores into the overall result. Invalid-output handling and weighting are part of the reproducibility contract.
  5. Refresh without erasing history. Periodically replace roughly one sixth of the questions with newer material and publish a new dated release. Preserve old versions so score drift can be separated from model change.

1. 定义可刷新的任务。 输入近期竞赛、论文、新闻、代码和表格来源，并结合任务生成器，在数学、代码、推理、语言、指令跟随和数据分析六类中构造高难问题，产出带来源日期的任务记录。
  2. 配置客观检查。 为每个任务提供标准答案、可执行测试或任务专用指标；核心分数不采用无约束的 LLM judge。checker 决定回答何时算正确。
  3. 冻结一个 release。 论文版本把 1,000 道题、18 个任务和 6 个类别连同 prompt 与 scorer 版本打包。报告结果时必须写明具体 release，而不能只写“LiveBench”。
  4. 运行并汇总。 在固定模型端点和 decoding 设置下生成回答，用各任务 checker 评分，再汇总成任务分、类别分和总分。无效输出处理与权重同样属于复现契约。
  5. 刷新但保留历史。 定期用新材料替换约六分之一题目并发布新的日期版本，同时保留旧版本，使 benchmark 变化与模型变化能够分开分析。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. Difficulty and coverage: on the fixed 1,000-question, 18-task, six-category paper release, o1-preview obtains an overall score of 64.7 rather than saturating the benchmark. This shows that the objectively scored mixture remains challenging for a leading model under the paper's aggregation, but the number is meaningful only for that release and model version.
  2. Refresh stability: across two reported updates, model-ranking correlations with the preceding release remain above 0.997 while approximately one sixth of questions are replaced per update. This supports refreshability without wholesale ranking disruption for the evaluated model set; it does not prove that every future task mix preserves the same construct.

1. 难度与覆盖： 在固定的论文版本上，1,000 道题覆盖 18 个任务和 6 个类别，o1-preview 的总分为 64.7，并未把 benchmark 做到接近满分。这说明在论文的汇总规则下，这套客观评分任务对领先模型仍有难度；但该数字只对应这一 release 和模型版本。
  2. 刷新稳定性： 论文报告的两次更新每次替换约六分之一题目，而模型排名与前一版本的相关性都高于 0.997。这支持“刷新题目而不彻底打乱当前模型排序”，但不能保证未来任何任务组合都测量同一个能力结构。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Static benchmarks treat the question set as fixed, and arena-style evaluations often rely on subjective judges. LiveBench changes the auditable unit to a dated task record with an objective checker and makes scheduled replacement part of benchmark operation. Objective metrics and versioning are not individually new; their combination specifically targets contamination and score reproducibility. The resulting direction signal is to compare releases as measurement versions, not silently merge them into one leaderboard history.
静态 benchmark 把题集视为固定对象，arena 式评测又常依赖主观 judge。LiveBench 把可审计单位改成带日期且配有客观 checker 的任务记录，并把定期替换写入 benchmark 运行方式。客观指标和版本管理单独看都不是新技术；新意在于将两者组合起来，专门处理污染与分数复现。它给出的方向信号是把不同 release 当作测量版本比较，而不是悄悄合并成一段排行榜历史。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Fresh is not unseen: models may have encountered related sources or generated variants before evaluation. Audit source dates, model-access dates, and semantic overlap rather than claiming zero contamination.
  • Release drift: replacing questions changes the measurement target, so scores from different releases are not directly interchangeable. Preserve old task files and report both within-release comparisons and cross-release changes.
  • Checker scope: objective scoring improves reproducibility only for properties encoded by the checker; bugs and narrow answer formats can mis-score valid behavior. Version the scorer and manually inspect representative failures.

• 新鲜不等于从未见过： 模型可能在评测前见过相关来源或生成变体。应审计来源日期、模型访问日期和语义重叠，而不能宣称零污染。
  • Release 漂移： 替换题目会改变测量目标，因此不同 release 的分数不能直接互换。要保留旧任务文件，并分别报告同版本比较和跨版本变化。
  • Checker 覆盖有限： 客观评分只对 checker 能表达的属性提高可复现性；程序错误或过窄答案格式也会误判有效回答。应给 scorer 做版本管理并人工检查代表性失败。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use LiveBench when an LLM comparison needs a contamination-aware, reproducible evaluation surface. Pin a release, preserve prompts and scorers, record model endpoint and decoding, and report task/category results before the aggregate score; for longitudinal evaluation, rerun anchor models on both old and new releases. The output is a versioned regression record, not a timeless capability number. It is unsuitable for claims such as safety or factuality when the selected tasks and checkers do not measure them.
当 LLM 对比需要考虑污染并保证可复现时，可以采用 LiveBench：固定一个 release，保存 prompt 与 scorer，记录模型端点和 decoding，并在总分前先报告任务分与类别分；做纵向评测时，还要让锚点模型同时重跑新旧版本。产物是版本化的回归记录，而不是永恒不变的能力数字。若所选任务和 checker 没有测量安全性或事实性，就不能据此提出相应结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Object: a LiveBench score is inseparable from its dated release, task set, and scorer version.
  • Scale: the paper release has 1,000 questions, 18 tasks, and six categories.
  • Feedback: core evaluation uses objective or task-specific checks rather than an open-ended LLM judge.
  • Evidence: o1-preview scores 64.7, and two refreshes preserve ranking correlation above 0.997 for the tested models.
  • Audit: freshness limits fixed-test memorization but still requires provenance, semantic-overlap, checker, and release-drift checks.

• 对象：LiveBench 分数必须与日期 release、任务集和 scorer 版本一起解释。
  • 规模：论文版本有 1,000 道题、18 个任务和 6 个类别。
  • 反馈：核心评测使用客观或任务专用检查，而不是开放式 LLM judge。
  • 证据：o1-preview 得分 64.7；两次刷新对测试模型都保持高于 0.997 的排名相关性。
  • 审计：新鲜度只限制固定测试记忆，仍要检查 provenance、语义重叠、checker 和 release 漂移。
